title: From an Arch laptop to an iPhone

steps.title: Install the toolchain
steps.note: swiftly with a Swift 6 toolchain, xtool with the Darwin SDK, libimobiledevice for usbmuxd and idevice_id, and Impactor at ~/.local/opt/Impactor.AppImage.

steps.title: Point it at your server
steps.note: VIGIE_TUNNEL for the public address, VIGIE_LAN for the fallback at home. Without this file the build embeds the example addresses.

steps.title: Build the app
steps.note: Checks the SDK, writes .build/Info.plist from the template with your addresses, runs xtool dev build --ipa, and prints the size of xtool/Vigie.ipa.

steps.title: Put it on the phone
steps.note: Rebuilds, checks usbmuxd, names the connected iPhone, opens Impactor. Dragging the IPA in to sign and install is the one manual gesture.
